items.title: Every h cover of an affine scheme is refined by a finite affine cover of a surjective proper finitely presented morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an affine scheme X and an h covering {X_i -> X}, the lemma asserts that there is a surjective proper morphism Y -> X of finite presentation, with a finite affine open covering Y = Y_1 cup ... cup Y_m whose members refine the given covering (statement lines 10302-10312). The proof begins with the definition of an h covering: there is a proper surjective Y -> X with a finite affine open covering refining {X_i -> X}, say with morphisms h_j : Y_j -> X_{i_j} over X, and the whole problem is that Y -> X need not be of finite presentation (proof lines 10314-10325). By Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-proper-limit-of-proper-finite-presentation the morphism Y -> X is a directed limit of schemes Y_lambda proper and of finite presentation over X with closed immersion transition maps, and each Y_lambda -> X is still surjective (proof lines 10327-10333). Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-descend-opens then spreads the cover to quasi-compact opens Y_{lambda,j} covering Y_lambda and restricting to Y_j, and after increasing lambda the Y_{lambda,j} may be assumed affine by Limits, Lemma labelled limits-lemma-limit-affine (proof lines 10335-10341). Finally the functorial characterisation of morphisms locally of finite presentation (Limits, Proposition labelled limits-proposition-characterize-locally-finite-presentation) applies because the X_i -> X are locally of finite presentation, giving morphisms h_{lambda,j} : Y_{lambda,j} -> X_{i_j} restricting to h_j for a suitable lambda, so the approximating cover refines the given one (proof lines 10343-10353). Descending the cover and the refinement maps through the directed limit, and using the finite presentation of the targets to make the descent work, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
